description: Reviewed model-track registry (D-053, issue #117): stable capability families over changing physical slugs. Slug patterns, classifications and conservative capability floors are owner-approved evidence; the runtime never derives them. Exact model-catalog.json entries always take precedence over a track floor.

floor.rationale: One level below every reviewed gpt-5.6-sol rating (catalog: 5/5/5/5/5/5 at high effort), because runtime listing never proves capability. The owner-approved workflow roles (model-policy.json: GPT-5.6 Sol as the calibrated alternate under GPT-6-generation references) corroborate family continuity across generations. A new sol generation routes only against this floor until its own dated evidence lands.
floor.continuity_rationale: Family-continuity assumption (gpt-5.6 evidenced values), deliberately conservative pending direct evidence for the new generation. The runtime remains the true enforcement boundary: an over-limit request fails honestly at the source.

floor.rationale: Same deliberately conservative floor as the sol track: the live 0.155 runtime listing plus the owner-approved reference roles (model-policy.json assigns GPT-6 Astra as preferred reference for deep-execution/scientific/semantic-review roles with GPT-5.6 Sol High as the calibrated alternate) evidence family continuity, not per-dimension capability. This entry is the D-033 reconciliation: Astra becomes selector-eligible at floor level only through this reviewed artifact; stronger ratings require direct dated evidence.

floor.rationale: One level below the reviewed gpt-5.6-luna max-effort ratings (catalog: 4/4/3/5/5/4), preserving the family's evidenced shape (strong writing/tool use, moderate reasoning/science) without asserting parity for a new generation.

tracks.notes: D-054 (2026-09-26): light family — weak models are represented and floor-expanded at max reasoning effort only (effort_restriction max_only). GLM Flash (zai) is already max-only in the catalog; sol, astra, daybreak and the GLM-5.3 base family stay unrestricted.

Restricted security-review capability (D-053 point 9): separate approval/access may be required; discovery never proves execution authorization. Restricted tracks are surfaced honestly in inventory but never materialized as routable resources, never silently substituted, and consumed only by the explicit independent security-review gate.

Vendor-managed execution lane (D-063): the official ZCode CLI exposes no model listing and no headless model steering, so the lane's physical model is plan/vendor-managed and not controllable by Scarcity Router. The reserved descriptor slug 'plan-managed' is a router-side lane name, never a physical model claim. Routing to it means exactly 'execute through this ZCode plan-managed lane in the authorized workspace'.

floor.rationale: The only honest floor for a lane whose physical model is vendor-managed and unverifiable: the minimum of the rating scale on every dimension. This lane asserts NO model capability beyond 'a paid-plan coding lane exists'; strong ratings require a future supported surface that evidences the executing physical model. Execution-level facts are carried separately by the dated adapter compatibility cells (usage UNKNOWN, streaming/tools/structured output/effort control UNSUPPORTED).
floor.continuity_rationale: Family-continuity assumption over the reviewed plan family: model-catalog.json calibrates both GLM Coding Plan models (glm-5.3, glm-5.3-flash) at 1000000 input / 128000 output tokens, and the lane's physical model is vendor-managed within that plan. Deliberately conservative pending a supported surface that evidences the executing model; the runtime remains the true enforcement boundary.
